Know your Rancher and know your Food.  

Silo Springs Ranch is an all-natural grass-fed Angus beef operation in Culloden, GA. Run by Arlin and Audrey Gravelle, they raise cattle with room-to-roam and process humanely just 15 miles from the ranch. The beef is air-aged for 14 days before being hand-cut, vacuum-packed, and flash-frozen at peak freshness. Everything offered is USDA-certified and Beef Quality Assurance Certified.

We believe knowing where your beef comes from is key. 

We are over the moon to share this farm-to-table experience with you.

Just Us

Our small business is family run with Arlin and Audrey. You will also find Audrey’s Mom, Karen, at the markets. From time to time you will see the butchers at the markets too. We are small, we don’t use order numbers, we use your name. The same people at your local farmers’ market selected the cows, kept the herd healthy and happy, and look forward to helping you keep your freezer fully stocked. 

Find us in a Market near you!
Stress-free Herds

That’s our secret. 

It starts with the cows living quiet lives, with access to a variety of grasses, ponds, springs, fresh well-water, and shaded woods. We visit with the cows to check on them daily and that gets them used to seeing us. We even have large scratching posts for them to enjoy.

About
Silo Springs Ranch
About Silo Springs Ranch

Silo Springs Ranch is a family-owned and operated ranch in Culloden, Georgia, dedicated to raising high-quality, grass-fed, and grass-finished beef. My husband, Arlin, and I built our first herd together in 2020. By 2021, we were selling our first beef, and we’ve been hooked ever since.

Arlin comes from a long line of cattle ranchers—he’s a fifth-generation rancher, though from a very different climate in Saskatchewan, Canada. I’ve had a passion for ranching since my days in FFA, and after years in the construction industry (where Arlin and I met), we finally turned that dream into reality.

Raised Right, Every Step of the Way

At Silo Springs Ranch, we believe cattle should be raised the right way—naturally, with care and respect. Our cows eat as nature intended—just grass—growing at their own pace without hormones or steroids. We practice rotational grazing to keep our pastures healthy, and we select cattle with strong genetics, ensuring they thrive in our system. 

We also handle our cattle ourselves, keeping interactions as low-stress as possible. If a task stresses the herd, we pause and try again another day. Even on harvest day, our cattle are handled humanely by familiar people, ensuring the process is as calm as possible.

Our General Store & Where to Find Us

In 2024, we opened our general store right on Highway 341—the “Georgia Grown Highway.” This space allows us to offer a wider selection of beef, lamb, and pasture-raised chicken while giving customers a direct connection to their local rancher. Whether you stop by the store or visit us at a farmers’ market, you’ll always find either Arlin or Audrey behind the counter, and many times, our butcher joins us to help answer questions.

We believe in full transparency, and the beef we sell is exactly what we feed our own family. Everything is USDA-certified, vacuum-sealed, and completely free from preservatives, dyes, or added water —just honest, high-quality beef.

Stay Connected

You can find us at select farmers’ markets and our store in Culloden. We also share updates on beef availability, specials, and a behind-the-scenes look at ranch life on Facebook and Instagram.

If you have any questions, we love talking beef—give us a call at 678-852-9880.

Where it all began: Audrey’s silos and Arlin’s springs marked the birth of Silo Springs Ranch.

Ranch Naming

Silo Springs Ranch got its name after much brainstorming.  As a first-generation ranch being the owner of silos was a landmark for Audrey. As someone who comes from a dry and arid climate and having our own springs that bubbled out of the ground in our pastures was a landmark for Arlin. From there it was only natural that Silo Springs Ranch came to be. 

Arlin and Audrey Gravelle make up the 2A brand that is Silo Springs Ranch.

FAQs
What forms of payment do you accept?

We accept cash, all major credit/debit cards, and contactless payments like Google Pay and Apple Pay. If you’d like to pre-pay before picking up at the market, we can send an invoice via Square by email or text—just let us know when you order.

Are the cows yours?

Yes! We raise our own Angus cattle. Our herd started in 2020 with only Black Angus, but through research and experience, we’ve added Red Angus for its strong genetics and beef quality. .

Are your cows really grass-fed?

Yes! Our cattle are on a 100% grass-fed and grass-finished diet. They graze on a variety of pasture grasses and forage, choosing what they need for balanced nutrition. Unlike grain-fed beef, our cattle never receive grain at any stage.

Do I have to pre-order to pick up beef at a market?

Nope! Our freezer trailer is fully stocked with USDA-certified frozen beef, ready to take home. However, if you’re looking for something specific, we recommend pre-ordering to ensure availability. You can pre-order by calling or texting 678-852-9880 or placing an order through our website.

Do you sell pork?

Yes, we sell pasture-raised pork. We even sell quarter and half pig shares to help fill your freezer.

When is your beef processing season?

We harvest year-round, offering retail cuts, whole beef, half beef, and quarter beef sales 12 months a year.

Do you sell chicken?

Yes! We pasture-raise our chickens, and they are available fully processed as whole roasting chickens. 

Do you sell half or whole cows?

Yes! We offer:

Whole beef (custom cut or standard cut)

Half beef (custom or standard cut)

Quarter beef (standard cut)
Check out the Cow Shares section of our website for details.

When will you run your next special?

We run limited-time specials, announced on Facebook. Follow us there for updates!

Can we book a ranch tour?

Right now, we have too many irons in the fire to offer regular ranch tours. However, we plan to host “day-cations” on the ranch in the future! Follow us on Facebook for announcements.

Where do you get your beef processed?

Our cattle are humanely processed at York’s Butcher Shop in Barnesville, where Audrey works part-time to oversee the process. York’s uses no chemicals, just vinegar for food safety. Our beef is pure with no added water, dyes, or preservatives…. just honest, high-quality meat.

How do I store and thaw your beef?

Our beef is vacuum-sealed and frozen to preserve freshness. For best quality, store it in your freezer until you're ready to use it. To thaw, place it in the refrigerator overnight or use a cold water thawing method for faster results.

Do you offer delivery?

Currently, we do not offer delivery for individual orders. However, you can pick up your beef at the Perry Farmers Market, our Culloden general store, or through pre-order for easy pickup.

Our mission is simple: raise cattle the right-way, produce the best beef, and be a part of your family’s table.

FAQs on the Subscriptions
What is included in each subscription box?

Each box includes approximately 12 pounds of beef, featuring 6-8 pounds of ground beef, steaks, and a unique combination of cuts. Over 15 months, you'll receive the equivalent of half a cow. Each box also includes a tried-and-tested recipe.

Where can I pick up my subscription box?

Pickup is available at our farmers markets like Perry and at our general store in Culloden.

How is the beef packaged?

The beef is packaged in vacuum-sealed bags to ensure freshness and ease of storage.

How much does the subscription box cost?

The subscription box costs $140 per month. There are no contracts, and you can cancel anytime.

Can I customize the cuts of beef in my box?

While each box features a unique combination of cuts, we strive to provide a variety that allows you to enjoy different parts of the cow. Customizations are not available to maintain the variety and quality.

What if I don’t have enough freezer space?

Our subscription box is designed to be manageable even with limited freezer space. Receiving smaller monthly shipments means you don’t need to store a large amount of beef all at once.

How does the payment process work?

Payment links are sent out a week before the pickup date. You can pay online, making the process convenient and straightforward.

Is there a minimum commitment period?

There is no minimum commitment. You can start and stop your subscription at any time without any penalties.
